languages.name: Rust
languages.icon: <g transform="translate(42,38)"><rect x="-22" y="-22" width="44" height="44" rx="4" fill="#DEA584"/><text x="0" y="8" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Segoe UI',sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="900" fill="#ffffff">Rust</text></g>

facts.it: Rust garantisce memory safety senza garbage collector: il borrow checker analizza il codice a compile-time.
facts.en: Rust guarantees memory safety without garbage collection: the borrow checker analyzes code at compile-time.

facts.it: Rust è stato eleito "most beloved programming language" su Stack Overflow per 7 anni consecutivi (2016-2022).
facts.en: Rust was elected "most beloved programming language" on Stack Overflow for 7 consecutive years (2016-2022).

facts.it: Il compiler di Rust (rustc) è uno dei più veloci tra i linguaggi moderni: spesso più veloce di C++ in benchmark.
facts.en: Rust's compiler (rustc) is one of the fastest among modern languages: often faster than C++ in benchmarks.

languages.name: Go
languages.icon: <g transform="translate(42,38)"><circle cx="0" cy="0" r="22" fill="#00ADD8"/><text x="0" y="8" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Segoe UI',sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="900" fill="#ffffff">Go</text></g>

facts.it: Go è stato creato da Google nel 2007 da Robert Griesemer, Rob Pike e Ken Thompson (co-creatore di Unix e C).
facts.en: Go was created at Google in 2007 by Robert Griesemer, Rob Pike and Ken Thompson (co-creator of Unix and C).

facts.it: Il nome "Go" (non "Golang") deriva dal comando `go run` che avvia il programma. Golang è solo un nickname comunemente usato.
facts.en: The name "Go" (not "Golang") comes from the `go run` command that starts the program. Golang is just a commonly used nickname.

facts.it: Go ha introdotto le goroutine: thread lightweight gestiti dal runtime, non dal kernel, per concorrenza massiva efficiente.
facts.en: Go introduced goroutines: lightweight threads managed by the runtime, not the kernel, for efficient massive concurrency.
